src/backend/analyze.mjs.name: Company analysis
src/backend/analyze.mjs.description: Works out a company's analysis from its data: scores, gaps and where it stands compared with the market.

src/backend/analyze.test.mjs.name: Analysis checks
src/backend/analyze.test.mjs.description: Automatic checks that the company analysis gives the expected results.

src/backend/build_examples.py.name: Example vacancies
src/backend/build_examples.py.description: Picks example vacancies that show each kind of answer, so the demo has realistic examples.

src/backend/build_summary.py.name: Vacancy summary
src/backend/build_summary.py.description: Calculates the summary figures from the vacancy files, such as how many vacancies there are per year and company.

src/backend/chat.mjs.name: Chat logic
src/backend/chat.mjs.description: Handles one chat message from start to finish: checks the question, asks the agent, and sends back the answer.

src/backend/chat.test.mjs.name: Chat checks
src/backend/chat.test.mjs.description: Automatic checks that the chat answers questions and handles bad input properly.

src/backend/company_names.py.name: Company name cleaning
src/backend/company_names.py.description: Makes one company out of its different spellings, such as ING, ING Bank N.V. and ING Netherlands.

src/backend/Dockerfile.name: Backend container
src/backend/Dockerfile.description: The recipe that packages the backend so it runs the same way on any server.

src/backend/evals/cases.json.name: Test questions
src/backend/evals/cases.json.description: A list of test questions with the answers we expect, used to check the chat after changes.

src/backend/evals/run-evals.mjs.name: Run the chat tests
src/backend/evals/run-evals.mjs.description: Asks the chat each test question and reports which answers are right.

src/backend/mock/internal-bank.json.name: Demo company data
src/backend/mock/internal-bank.json.description: Made-up company figures the demo uses when no real data is loaded.

src/backend/mock/validate-mock.mjs.name: Check demo data
src/backend/mock/validate-mock.mjs.description: Checks that the demo company data has the fields the app expects.

src/backend/overview.mjs.name: Overview figures
src/backend/overview.mjs.description: Builds the company overview shown next to the chat: the key numbers and where they come from.

src/backend/overview.test.mjs.name: Overview checks
src/backend/overview.test.mjs.description: Automatic checks that the overview figures are right, including when a score is missing.

src/backend/readiness.mjs.name: AI readiness score
src/backend/readiness.mjs.description: Works out how ready a company is for AI, based on its vacancies and its own AI usage, with the reasons behind each score.

src/backend/readiness.test.mjs.name: Readiness checks
src/backend/readiness.test.mjs.description: Automatic checks that the AI readiness score gives the expected results.

src/backend/router.test.mjs.name: Routing checks
src/backend/router.test.mjs.description: Automatic checks that each question goes to the right model and the right amount of work.

src/backend/router.ts.name: Question router
src/backend/router.ts.description: Decides how much work a question needs, so simple questions get a cheap, fast answer and hard ones get more care.

src/backend/server.mjs.name: Backend server
src/backend/server.mjs.description: The server that listens for questions from the web app and sends each one to the chat logic.

src/backend/suggestions.mjs.name: Follow-up suggestions
src/backend/suggestions.mjs.description: Suggests the next question to ask, based on the question that was just answered.

src/backend/suggestions.test.mjs.name: Suggestion checks
src/backend/suggestions.test.mjs.description: Automatic checks that the follow-up suggestions fit the question asked.

src/lib/agent.test.ts.name: Agent checks
src/lib/agent.test.ts.description: Automatic checks that the agent uses its tools correctly and returns complete answers.

src/lib/agent.ts.name: The agent
src/lib/agent.ts.description: The assistant that reads the data, decides what to look up, and writes the answer. It can also draft a vacancy.

src/lib/data.test.ts.name: Data checks
src/lib/data.test.ts.description: Automatic checks that searching the company data finds the right records.

src/lib/data.ts.name: Company data search
src/lib/data.ts.description: Loads the company records and finds the ones that match a question, so the answers can cite their source.

src/lib/vacancies.test.ts.name: Vacancy search checks
src/lib/vacancies.test.ts.description: Automatic checks that the vacancy search and the yearly trend give the expected results.

src/lib/vacancies.ts.name: Vacancy search and trend
src/lib/vacancies.ts.description: Finds example vacancies that mention a skill, and shows how often that skill appears per year.

src/lib/vacancyDoc.test.ts.name: Vacancy document checks
src/lib/vacancyDoc.test.ts.description: Automatic checks that vacancy drafts turn into a complete Word file.

src/lib/vacancyDoc.ts.name: Vacancy document
src/lib/vacancyDoc.ts.description: Turns a vacancy draft into a Word file the person can download.
